images.prompt: Faithful high-resolution photographic detail restoration / precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY photographic quality of the supplied hotel-room photograph. Preserve the exact 3840x2160 canvas, camera angle, framing, geometry, room layout, bed, pillows, windows, curtains, posters, thermostat, wood door, furniture, colors and natural daylight. This is the same actual room, not a redesign. Make the entire image sharply focused edge-to-edge, as a professional architectural photograph at f/8, with genuinely resolved fine woven curtain texture, crisp sheer curtain folds, natural wood grain, fabric headboard and fine white striped bed linen. Remove soft painterly interpolation and compression haze. No bokeh, blur, plastic smoothing, oversharpening halos, fake luxury accessories, added furniture, new light fixtures, new text, landmarks or logos. Retain existing wall posters without inventing text. Output highest native detail and resolution available, target 3840 by 2160 pixels, 16:9. Do not present a webpage or UI; only the restored photograph.
